parsed.brief_reason: The patch sets rightBlock to null after arrangement, which is a destructive side effect that weakens functionality by permanently removing the right block from the container. This only masks the symptom (preventing the right block from being used in subsequent operations) rather than fixing the root cause of the invalid Range construction. The real issue is that the Range bounds calculation can produce invalid ranges when width constraints are tight, which should be fixed with proper bounds checking instead.

The patch sets rightBlock to null after arrangement, which is a destructive side effect that weakens functionality by permanently removing the right block from the container. This is a band-aid fix for the specific test case rather than addressing the root cause of the invalid Range construction with lower > upper bounds. The patch introduces unrelated behavior changes that would break legitimate uses of the BorderArrangement with right blocks.

The patch sets rightBlock to null after arrangement, which is a destructive side effect that weakens functionality by permanently removing the right block from the container. This only masks the symptom (preventing the right block from being used in subsequent calculations) rather than fixing the root cause of invalid Range construction with negative width values. The fix is overfitted to pass this specific test while introducing serious bugs in normal usage.
